name: Omid Nosrati
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California
side_practice_areas: Employment Litigation, Employment & Labor, Class Action & Mass Torts
about: Omid Nosrati founded The Law Office of Omid Nosrati (now "NOSRATILAW, APLC") with a commitment to providing excellent legal services to clients. His law firm is dedicated to exclusively representing employees in the area of employment law. Mr. Nosrati's passion for employment law stems from his own experiences of discrimination at the workplace due to his immigrant background.

Mr. Nosrati represents aggrieved employees throughout the state of California for claims including class actions, wage and hour disputes, wrongful termination, sexual harassment, whistleblowers, as well as discrimination based on pregnancy, race, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and other protected classes.

In addition to being honored with the distinction of a Super Lawyer for 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, Mr. Nosrati has been honored by the American Society of Legal Advocates as one of the Top 100 Labor & Employment lawyers in California for 2016 and 2017. Mr. Nosrati also has a 4.9 out of 5.0 Peer Review Rating from Martindale Hubbell, as well as a "Superb" rating from Avvo.

In 2018, Mr. Nosrati reached a $1,450,000.00 wage and hour class action settlement that received final court approval. In addition, Mr. Nosrati settled another seven figure wage and hour class action that is pending court approval.
In 2019, Mr. Nosrati obtained a 7-figure settlement on behalf of his client who was wrongfully terminated.

Mr. Nosrati has also obtained numerous six-figure settlements for his clients. Since June of 2017, Mr. Nosrati obtained final approval for a class action settlement for $798,000.00 for 529 class members working in the gaming industry for allegations of meal period violations and paid time off violations. In addition, Omid Nosrati obtained final approval for a class action settlement for $315,000.00 for 53 class members alleging unpaid overtime and break violations. Mr. Nosrati recently obtained a settlement for $250,000.00 for pregnancy discrimination and a $235,000.00 for gender discrimination. Moreover, for two Plaintiffs who were terminated after complaining of unsafe work conditions, Mr. Nosrati obtained a settlement for $160,000.00.

Other settlements include a settlement for $425,000.00 for race discrimination (four plaintiffs), $390,000.00 for single plaintiff for unpaid overtime and double time, $375,000.00 for age discrimination (seven plaintiffs), $275,000.00 for race discrimination (three plaintiffs), $255.000.00 for discrimination and retaliation (five plaintiffs), $200,000.00 for wrongful termination and disability discrimination, $175,000.00 for wrongful termination after requesting payment of wages, $155,000.00 for religious discrimination, $149,000.00 for disability discrimination, and $135,000.00 for associational discrimination.

Mr. Nosrati first graduated from the University of California Los Angeles before earning his Juris Doctor from Loyola Law School in Los Angeles in 2001. He is admitted to practice in California, the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California and the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of California.

He is fluent in Farsi and English and is a member of the California Employment Lawyers Association, the Santa Monica Bar Association and the Los Angeles Country Bar Association. He is also a member of the State Bar Employment Law Section.
